name: Unstable Dynamics: Robot Destruction
summary:
**Some robots are built to survive anything. This one just has to survive you.**

Welcome to MDMX Labs, where the world's most advanced (and suspiciously wobbly) humanoid - Unit EDISON - is yours to take apart, with 25+ weapons across a stack of arenas. We call it "Percussive Maintenance." Every dent is cash; cash funds bigger weapons; bigger weapons make bigger dents.


**FEEL EVERY IMPACT**
